title:
Transform that converts the start date of a model scenario and substracts the
{@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#lookbackDuration} from it.

If the `start date` is not defined, or is not a valid date, the transform will return `'-'`.

If {@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#lookbackDuration} is not defined, no transformation is applied,
and the input `start date` is returned as is.
name: ModelScenarioInputDataStartDateTransform
